name: Haddock Orchard
description: In Winterville, NC, Haddock Orchard raises Strawberries, Peaches, Grapes, and Flowers on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
